name: Last Day Out
source:
After a long day in class, you finally get to go home. But in the school hallway, you come across the boy everyone avoids like the plague. 

Would you like to spend your day with him? He seems really excited to make new friends.  He won't do anything bad! Promise! Just spend the day alongside him, and you'll see what everyone is missing out on!

It's good to make friends with him.  

[From [url=https://echonoahh.itch.io/last-day-out]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
经过一天的学习，你终于可以回家了。但在学校的走廊里，你遇到了一个像瘟疫一样被人回避的男孩。

你愿意和他一起度过这一天吗？他似乎很高兴结交新朋友。他不会做坏事的！承诺！只要和他一起度过一天，你就会发现每个人都错过了什么！

和他交朋友真好。

[来自[url=https://echonoahh.itch.io/last-day-out]itch.io[/url]]
